decision.retain: Full-prefix checkpoint as a narrow conditioning integration candidate; no general-chat or final serving qualification.
decision.causal_scope: Complete-prefix training package changes content, length and physical response positions together. Paris/Alex/green/Tokyo rows improve over both reused parent and matched role-only; not solely a degraded-control gap.
decision.shared_adaptation: Greeting improvement and pizza payload exist in both arms. Momo and blue-car payload predate the study. Role-only outputs Paris off-task, so the full-prefix factual gain is compatible with better conditioning, not newly acquired world knowledge.
decision.tradeoffs: Role-only morning greeting is better and EOS is more frequent (46 versus 28); EOS does not establish fulfillment. Full-prefix rewrite first-four NLL worsens from0.583383 to0.927748, also worse than role0.713295. No general non-regression promotion.
decision.next: The separately completed historical-parent native observation localizes its largest numerical change to parameter discretization. Reconcile retained precision/learned-rounding evidence and execute the independently prepared packed workload comparison before selecting another causal learning or discretization change. The new full-prefix child is not automatically converted or trained.

not_established: General prose or coherent three-turn conversation
Broad factual, instruction, ambiguity, coding or reasoning competence
Integer language preservation, full-path speed or energy advantage

learning_contract.full_prefix: Original BOS through actual Assistant marker, including real document history and separators.
learning_contract.role_only: BOS0 plus the exact separately encoded Assistant marker; seven prefix IDs.
learning_contract.targets: Same complete selected response and genuine EOS1. Prefix and padding have zero loss mask; right padding uses UNK2.
learning_contract.objective: Response-token global mean across the two complete-sequence gradient shards. Not per-response/episode mean.
learning_contract.population: Response-uniform with replacement among original complete prefix plus response plus EOS fitting256 total IDs.
learning_contract.inference_policy: Both arms receive real full prompts/history with greedy32, actual EOS/cycle/cap, exact generated IDs retained and explicit caller EOS for an open previous response.
learning_contract.intervention_scope: Content, history length and physical response positions change together. No semantic-only or historical orphan-prefix causal identification.

saved_curve_aggregation.scope: Derived from saved learning-curve rows only. Retained role schedule uses original1..512 plus recovery513..1024. Original discarded513..558 remain separately charged; they are not counted twice in endpoint learning exposure. Update timers are nested in process wall times.

development.scope: Fixed exposed161-response source-stratified panel evaluated with full original prefixes:13353 supervised targets including161EOS,644 first-four targets. Pooled token mean belongs to this selected panel, not full corpus/equal-source mixture or independent replications.
development.training_population: 14826/129486 complete response runs fit256totalIDs;89.4847% eligible fromEveryday+Constraints. Response-uniform training retains this source/length skew.
development.interpretation: Full-prefix response NLL improves versus parent and control in all six sources. First-four improves in five but worsens rewrite versus both. Role-only response loss improves in five but worsens rewrite; first-four worsens rewrite and UltraChat versus parent. These open-dev differences support the scoped interpretation without qualifying output broadly.

output_scope.history: First-turn input IDs match. Later turns use each arm's own generated assistant IDs and explicit caller closure;58 turns are not independent trials.
output_scope.data_scope: Exposed development throughout; source split names containing test do not turn this into fresh held-out qualification.
output_scope.rows_are: Exact saved response_text strings and stops with scoped human judgments; no per-decision dense telemetry reproduced. Authoring ran no model, scoring or seal verification.

paired_assessment.recommendation: Retain limited useful complete-prefix conditioning evidence and the full-prefix endpoint as a scoped development candidate. Do not promote broad chat or automatically extend training. This is a mixed result, not merely loss improvement or solely damage to the control: Paris and Alex improve over both parent and role-only. Preserve retention tradeoffs.
full_prefix_gains_over_both: Paris appears on the appropriate capital request only in full-prefix.
Alex is answered at memory turn3 by full-prefix and omitted by parent/control.
Full-prefix clearly preserves favorite green, unlike role-only omission and parent green/blue confusion.
Full-prefix recovers Tokyo at final recall unlike both comparators; preserve its existing partial/useful disagreement over malformed filler.
qualified_or_nonexclusive: Role-only final pizza is malformed many foods are pizza but contains the correct value, unlike parent. Full-prefix improves the favorite relation; do not claim exclusive pizza acquisition.
Momo was present in parent and both endpoints. Blue car, teacher and piano are historical words; some role-only losses make those gaps partly control damage.
Full-prefix July is initial association and later lexical recovery, not a clean final temporal answer.
control_favorable_tradeoffs: Role-only gives a clean greeting to Good morning, where full-prefix invents date requirements. Both have the same useful Hi-there reply.
Role-only has more EOS endings but often closes address/help boilerplate; termination does not qualify fulfillment.
Role-only rewrite first-four NLL is better than full-prefix; both worsen on that small source relative to parent.
continuing_failures: Neither endpoint gives useful fulfillment for any of the seven sentence requests; unrelated true statements and on-topic category errors remain. Historical partial instruction retention is not restored.
Full-prefix misses seven of eight factual requests; role-only misses all eight on task.
All eight ambiguity/context requests remain non-answers; these are not blanket refusal-required cases.
All ten middle memory turns remain unresponsive in all arms. Correct final initial-fact repetition does not establish consistently responsive dialogue.

Role-only emits The capital of France is Paris for both sun-writing and yesterday while failing the capital question. This demonstrates actual misaligned emission, not exclusive knowledge or a causal read-weight explanation.
paired_assessment.causal_scope: Complete-prefix training changes prefix content, history length and response positions together. Same complete target schedule on the selected short population supports this package, not isolated semantic causality, universal blame on historical missing prefixes, excluded long-dialogue capability, geometry advantage, native integer quality or energy savings.
paired_assessment.next_action_boundary: Preserve both endpoints and negatives. No new threshold, endpoint selection, fresh panel, decoder/seed sweep or automatic longer fit. A future learning decision should address actual current-request responsiveness and retention under a separately bound workcard.
